findings.title: Not-covered output omits nearest review
findings.description: `checkTree` drops reviews from other repositories, and reviews whose base commit this checkout lacks, before it picks `nearest`. `main` only exits 2 when the unfiltered list is empty, so when every saved review is filtered out it prints "no saved review with a recorded tree was found" and exits 1 with no nearest tree or age, contradicting the docs' exit 2 for "no saved review found".

findings.title: Unreadable pull reviews block the gate
findings.description: `walk()` records a listing failure inside `reviews/` even though `readReviewRecords()` excludes that subtree from local-review evidence. If pull-request review saves are unreadable while local reviews are readable, an uncovered tree exits 2 instead of reporting not covered with exit 1.

openFindings.title: Another repository's review can cover a tree
openFindings.description: `checkTree` rejects a foreign repository only when the review has a non-null `repo`, while records without a sidecar receive `repo: null`. If two configured repositories have identical trees, an unlabelled complete review from one can make the other report covered; the new test explicitly accepts that case.
